caption: The drawing features two bonnets, both rendered in soft shades of beige and off-white. The larger bonnet, which occupies most of the upper right portion of the composition, is depicted in side view and is made of fabric with delicate dot patterns, eyelet lace bands, and multiple gathered sections creating a ruffled texture. There are visible seams and embroidered lines dividing the bonnet into segments, and loose ties extend from both sides near the front. The lower left part of the image contains a smaller bonnet, similar in color but without the lace details, displaying a plain, gathered body with a single gathered band at the edge and simple fabric ties. The background is plain and uncluttered, allowing clear focus on the details of the bonnets. The artist's name, "Lillian Causey," is written in small text to the right of the smaller bonnet.
title: Baby's Cap
